heading.en: The baptism of little children is an evil abomination—Little children are alive in Christ because of the Atonement—Faith, repentance, meekness and lowliness of heart, receiving the Holy Ghost, and enduring to the end lead to salvation. About A.D. 401–21.
heading.sm: O le papatisoina o tamaiti laiti o se mea leaga inosia—Ua ola tamaiti laiti ia Keriso ona o le Togiola—O le faatuatua, salamo, agamalu ma le maualalo o le loto, mauaina o le Agaga Paia, ma le tumau e oo i le iuga, e tau atu i le faaolataga. E tusa o le 401–421 T.A.

verses.en: An epistle of my father Mormon, written to me, Moroni; and it was written unto me soon after my calling to the ministry. And on this wise did he write unto me, saying:
verses.sm: O se tusi a lo’u tamā o Mamona, na tusi mai ia te a’u, o Moronae; ma sa tusi mai ia te a’u ae le’i pine ona uma ona valaauina o a’u i le galuega. Ma sa faapenei ona ia tusi mai ia te a’u, fai mai:

verses.en: My beloved son, Moroni, I rejoice exceedingly that your Lord Jesus Christ hath been mindful of you, and hath called you to his ministry, and to his holy work.
verses.sm: Lo’u atalii pele e, Moronae, ou te olioli tele ona ua manatu mai lou Alii o Iesu Keriso ia te oe, ma ua ia valaauina oe i lana auaunaga, ma i lana galuega paia.

verses.en: I am mindful of you always in my prayers, continually praying unto God the Father in the name of his Holy Child, Jesus, that he, through his infinite goodness and grace, will keep you through the endurance of faith on his name to the end.
verses.sm: Ou te manatu pea ia te oe i a’u talosaga, ma tatalo atu pea i le Atua le Tamā, i le suafa o lona Alo Paia, o Iesu, ia ona tausia oe, e ala i lona agalelei e le gata ma lona alofa tunoa, i le tumau i le faatuatua i lona suafa e oo i le iuga.

verses.en: And now, my son, I speak unto you concerning that which grieveth me exceedingly; for it grieveth me that there should disputations rise among you.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, ou te tautala atu ia te oe e uiga i lena mea ua ou faanoanoa tele ai: auā ou te faanoanoa ina ne’i tula’i mai ni finauga i totonu ia te outou.

verses.en: For, if I have learned the truth, there have been disputations among you concerning the baptism of your little children.
verses.sm: Auā, afai ua ou iloaina le mea moni, sa i ai ni finauga i totonu ia te outou e uiga i le papatisoina o a outou fanau laiti.

verses.en: And now, my son, I desire that ye should labor diligently, that this gross error should be removed from among you; for, for this intent I have written this epistle.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, ou te manao ia e galue ma le filigā, ina ia aveeseina lenei sese matuia mai totonu ia te outou; auā, o le faamoemoe lenei ua ou tusia ai lenei tusi.

verses.en: For immediately after I had learned these things of you I inquired of the Lord concerning the matter. And the word of the Lord came to me by the power of the Holy Ghost, saying:
verses.sm: Auā e le’i pine ona mavae ona ou iloa o nei mea mai ia te oe, sa ou ole atu i le Alii e uiga i le mataupu. Ma sa oo mai ia te a’u le afioga a le Alii e ala i le mana o le Agaga Paia, ua fetalai mai:

verses.en: Listen to the words of Christ, your Redeemer, your Lord and your God. Behold, I came into the world not to call the righteous but sinners to repentance; the whole need no physician, but they that are sick; wherefore, little children are whole, for they are not capable of committing sin; wherefore the curse of Adam is taken from them in me, that it hath no power over them; and the law of circumcision is done away in me.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai i upu a Keriso, lou Togiola, lou Alii ma lou Atua. Faauta, ou te le’i sau i le lalolagi e valaau atu i e amiotonu ae o e agasala ia salamo; ua le manaomia e e ua maloloina se fomai, ae o i latou o e ua mama’i; o le mea lea, ua atoatoa tamaiti laiti, ona ua le mafai ona latou faia se agasala; o le mea lea ua aveese ai le fetuu o Atamu, mai ia te i latou, e ala ia te a’u, ona ua leai sona mana i luga ia te i latou; ma ua aveeseina le tulafono o le peritomeina, e ala ia te a’u.

verses.en: And after this manner did the Holy Ghost manifest the word of God unto me; wherefore, my beloved son, I know that it is solemn mockery before God, that ye should baptize little children.
verses.sm: Ma o le ala lenei na faaali mai ai e le Agaga Paia ia te a’u le afioga a le Atua; o le mea lea, lo’u atalii pele e, ua ou iloa ai o se faifai tugā i luma o le Atua, lo outou papatisoina o fanau laiti.

verses.en: Behold I say unto you that this thing shall ye teach—repentance and baptism unto those who are accountable and capable of committing sin; yea, teach parents that they must repent and be baptized, and humble themselves as their little children, and they shall all be saved with their little children.
verses.sm: Faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou o le mea lenei ia outou a’oa’o atu— o le salamo ma le papatisoga ia i latou o e ua mafai ona tali atu ma mafai ona faia le agasala; ioe, a’oa’ o atu i matua e tatau ona latou salamo ma papatisoina, ma faalotomaualalalo i latou lava e pei o a latou fanau laiti, ma o le a faaolaina ai i latou uma faatasi ma a latou fanau laiti.

verses.en: And their little children need no repentance, neither baptism. Behold, baptism is unto repentance to the fulfilling the commandments unto the remission of sins.
verses.sm: Ma e le manaomia e a latou fanau laiti se salamo, po o le papatisoga. Faauta, o le papatisoga ua mo le salamo i le faataunuuina o poloaiga mo le faamagaloina o agasala.

verses.en: But little children are alive in Christ, even from the foundation of the world; if not so, God is a partial God, and also a changeable God, and a respecter to persons; for how many little children have died without baptism!
verses.sm: Ae o fanau laiti ua ola ia Keriso, mai lava i le faavaega o le lalolagi; afai ua le faapea, o le Atua o se Atua e faaituau, ma o se Atua fesuisuiai foi, ma o sē ua faailoga tagata; ona e to’a fia fanau laiti ua feoti e aunoa ma le papatisoga!

verses.en: Wherefore, if little children could not be saved without baptism, these must have gone to an endless hell.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai e le mafai ona faaolaina o fanau laiti e aunoa ma le papatisoga, atonu ua o atu i latou i le seoli e le gata.

verses.en: Behold I say unto you, that he that supposeth that little children need baptism is in the gall of bitterness and in the bonds of iniquity; for he hath neither faith, hope, nor charity; wherefore, should he be cut off while in the thought, he must go down to hell.
verses.sm: Faauta ou te fai atu ia te oe, o ia o lē ua manatu ua manaomia e fanau laiti le papatisoga, ua i ai o ia i le au oona ma noataga o le amioletonu; auā ua le i ai ia te ia le faatuatua, faamoemoe, po o le alofa mamā; o le mea lea, afai e vavae ese o ia a’o i ai ia te ia lea manatu, o le a alu ifo o ia i seoli.

verses.en: For awful is the wickedness to suppose that God saveth one child because of baptism, and the other must perish because he hath no baptism.
verses.sm: Ona ua matautia le amioleaga e manatu faapea e faaolaina e le Atua se tasi tamaitiiti ona ua papatisoina, ae o le a fano le isi ona ua le papatisoina.

verses.en: Wo be unto them that shall pervert the ways of the Lord after this manner, for they shall perish except they repent. Behold, I speak with boldness, having authority from God; and I fear not what man can do; for perfect love casteth out all fear.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou e faapi’opi’o ala o le Alii e tusa ma lenei faiga, ona o le a fano i latou vagana ai ua latou salamo. Faauta, ou te tautala atu ma le lotoa, ona ua ou maua le pule mai le Atua; ma ou te le fefe po o a mea e mafai ona faia e tagata; ona e lafoaiina i fafo e le alofa ua atoatoa le fefe uma.

verses.en: And I am filled with charity, which is everlasting love; wherefore, all children are alike unto me; wherefore, I love little children with a perfect love; and they are all alike and partakers of salvation.
verses.sm: Ma ua tumu a’u i le alofa mamā, le alofa tumau e faavavau lea; o le mea lea, ua tutusa fanau laiti uma ia te a’u; o le mea lea, ua ou alofa i fanau laiti i se alofa ua atoatoa; ma ua tutusa i latou uma ma ua maua e i latou le faaolataga.

verses.en: For I know that God is not a partial God, neither a changeable being; but he is unchangeable from all eternity to all eternity.
verses.sm: Ona ua ou iloa o le Atua e le o se Atua e faaituau, po o se tagata ua fesuisuiai; ae ua le fesuisuiai lava o ia mai le vavau atoa e oo i le faavavau atoa.

verses.en: Little children cannot repent; wherefore, it is awful wickedness to deny the pure mercies of God unto them, for they are all alive in him because of his mercy.
verses.sm: E le mafai e fanau laiti ona salamo; o le mea lea, o se amioleaga tele le faafitia o le alofa mutimutivale mamā o le Atua ia te i latou, ona ua ola uma i latou ia te ia ona o lona alofa mutimutivale.

verses.en: And he that saith that little children need baptism denieth the mercies of Christ, and setteth at naught the atonement of him and the power of his redemption.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e fai mai e manaomia e fanau laiti le papatisoga ua faafitia le alofa mutimutivale o Keriso, ma fai ma meanoa lana togiola ma le mana o lana faaolataga.

verses.en: Wo unto such, for they are in danger of death, hell, and an endless torment. I speak it boldly; God hath commanded me. Listen unto them and give heed, or they stand against you at the judgment-seat of Christ.
verses.sm: Oi talofa i ē faapea, ona ua lamatia i latou e le oti, seoli, ma le mafatia e le gata. Ou te tautala atu ia upu ma le lotoa; ua poloaiina ai a’u e le Atua. Ia outou faalogo ia i latou ma ua’i i ai, po ua latou teena outou i le nofoa-faamasino o Keriso.

verses.en: For behold that all little children are alive in Christ, and also all they that are without the law. For the power of redemption cometh on all them that have no law; wherefore, he that is not condemned, or he that is under no condemnation, cannot repent; and unto such baptism availeth nothing—
verses.sm: Auā faauta, ua ola fanau laiti uma ia Keriso, ma i latou uma foi o ē ua aunoa ma le tulafono. Auā e oo mai le mana o le togiola i luga o i latou uma o ē ua aunoa ma le tulafono; o le mea lea, o ia o lē ua le ta’usalaina, po o ia o lē ua le i lalo o se ta’usalaga, e le mafai ona salamo; ma o ē faapena ua le aogā i ai le papatisoga—

verses.en: But it is mockery before God, denying the mercies of Christ, and the power of his Holy Spirit, and putting trust in dead works.
verses.sm: Ae o se faifai i luma o le Atua, ua faafitia ai le alofa mutimutivale o Keriso, ma le mana o lona Agaga Paia, ma le tuuina atu o le faalagolago i galuega mamate.

verses.en: Behold, my son, this thing ought not to be; for repentance is unto them that are under condemnation and under the curse of a broken law.
verses.sm: Faauta, lo’u atalii e, e le tatau lava ona i ai o lenei mea; ona o le salamo e mo i latou ua i ai i lalo o le ta’usalaga ma lalo o le fetuu o se tulafono ua solia.

verses.en: And the first fruits of repentance is baptism; and baptism cometh by faith unto the fulfilling the commandments; and the fulfilling the commandments bringeth remission of sins;
verses.sm: Ma o fua muamua o le salamo o le papatisoga; ma o le papatisoga e oo mai e ala i le faatuatua e faataunuu ai poloaiga; ma o le faataunuuina o poloaiga e maua ai le faamagaloina o agasala;

verses.en: And the remission of sins bringeth meekness, and lowliness of heart; and because of meekness and lowliness of heart cometh the visitation of the Holy Ghost, which Comforter filleth with hope and perfect love, which love endureth by diligence unto prayer, until the end shall come, when all the saints shall dwell with God.
verses.sm: Ma o le faamagaloina o agasala e maua ai le agamalu, ma le maualalo o le loto; ma o le agamalu ma le maualalo o le loto e oo mai ai le asiasiga a le Agaga Paia, o le Fesoasoani lea na te faatumuina le tagata i le faamoemoe ma le alofa atoatoa, o le alofa lea e tumau e ala i le filigā i le tatalo, seia oo mai le iuga, pe a mau le au paia uma faatasi ma le Atua.

verses.en: Behold, my son, I will write unto you again if I go not out soon against the Lamanites. Behold, the pride of this nation, or the people of the Nephites, hath proven their destruction except they should repent.
verses.sm: Faauta, lo’u atalii e, o le a ou toe tusi atu ia te oe pe a le vave ona ou alu atu e faasagatau ia sa Lamanā. Faauta, o le faamaualuluga o lenei atunuu, po o tagata o sa Nifaē, ua faamaonia ai lo latou faaumatiaga vagana ai o le a latou salamo.

verses.en: Pray for them, my son, that repentance may come unto them. But behold, I fear lest the Spirit hath ceased striving with them; and in this part of the land they are also seeking to put down all power and authority which cometh from God; and they are denying the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ia e tatalo mo i latou, lo’u atalii e, ina ia oo mai le salamo ia te i latou. Peitai faauta, ou te fefe ne’i le toe finafinau le Agaga ma i latou; ma i le vaega lenei o le laueleele, o loo latou saili foi e faatoilalo le mana ma le pule atoa lea e mai le Atua; ma ua latou teena le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: And after rejecting so great a knowledge, my son, they must perish soon, unto the fulfilling of the prophecies which were spoken by the prophets, as well as the words of our Savior himself.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou teena se malamalama tele naua, lo’u atalii e, o le a vave ona fano o i latou, i le faataunuuina o valoaga na fetalai i ai perofeta, faapea foi ma fetalaiga a lo tatou Faaola lava ia.

verses.en: Farewell, my son, until I shall write unto you, or shall meet you again. Amen.
verses.sm: Tofa ia, lo’u atalii e, seia ou tusi atu ia te oe, pe seia ta toe feiloai. Amene.
